long_biography.plain_text:
IBS began in 1992 with twelve employees and a practical focus on corporate information systems. Its first major assignment automated deposit services for Sberbank branches. Under Anatoly Mikhailovich Karachinsky, the company expanded across systems integration, consulting, infrastructure and software development, becoming a substantial technology-services group.

The group's software-development centre became Luxoft, created to serve international clients. Luxoft grew into a global digital-engineering business, listed its shares in New York and was eventually acquired by DXC Technology. IBS's corporate university ran a master's programme with the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology and supported software-engineering education.
long_biography.html:
IBS began in 1992 with twelve employees and a practical focus on corporate information systems. Its first major assignment automated deposit services for Sberbank branches. Under Anatoly Mikhailovich Karachinsky, the company expanded across systems integration, consulting, infrastructure and software development, becoming a substantial technology-services group.

The group's software-development centre became Luxoft, created to serve international clients. Luxoft grew into a global digital-engineering business, listed its shares in New York and was eventually acquired by DXC Technology. IBS's corporate university ran a master's programme with the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology and supported software-engineering education.
